Stage 12 native R FPCA cross-validation and uncertainty-result frames

etr_native_cv_uncertainty.Rd

Python-free leakage-aware functional PCA cross-validation with explicit component selection and deterministic adapters for previously computed uncertainty and prediction results.

Usage

etr_cross_validate_fpca_reconstruction(trajectories,
  candidate_components = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L), n_splits = 5L, scaling = "none",
  cv_unit = "curve", group_column = NULL, shuffle = TRUE, random_state = 0L,
  fold_assignments = NULL, random_engine = "base_R", group_tie_order = "native")
etr_summarise_fpca_cross_validation(result)
etr_select_fpca_components_cv(result, rule = "minimum")
etr_summarise_fpca_regression_cv(result)
etr_select_fpca_regression_components(result, rule = "minimum")
etr_fpca_score_uncertainty_frame(result)
etr_fpca_spectrum_uncertainty_frame(result)
etr_conformal_fpca_anomaly_frame(result)
etr_trajectory_distance_comparison_frame(result)
etr_trajectory_distance_neighbor_frame(result)
etr_fpca_regression_slope_band_frame(result)
etr_fpca_regression_slope_uncertainty_frame(result)
etr_fpca_regression_prediction_uncertainty_frame(result)
etr_fpca_regression_future_prediction_frame(result)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete native common-grid curves.

candidate_components

Positive integer counts, deduplicated and sorted.

n_splits

Number of held-out partitions, at least two.

scaling

Declared functional channel scaling.

cv_unit

Use curve-level or group-level partitioning.

group_column

Required metadata column for grouped holdouts.

shuffle

Whether to shuffle curve order prior to fold assignment.

random_state

Nonnegative integer seed for the selected shuffle engine.

group_tie_order

Grouped sort profile. Use "numpy_simd" or "numpy_scalar" for the corresponding NumPy 2.3.5 integer sort used by scikit-learn GroupKFold. "native" uses the original R group policy. Explicit fold_assignments take precedence.

random_engine

"base_R" retains the original native shuffle. "numpy" reproduces scikit-learn's seeded NumPy RandomState permutation for seeds up to \(2^{32}-1\).

fold_assignments

Optional numeric vector of zero-based source-fold IDs, one per curve; all declared folds must occur and grouped curves may not be split. Replays externally observed folds without invoking Python.

result

Native FPCA CV object, declared regression CV object or a source-shaped, previously computed uncertainty structure.

rule

Explicit minimum or one-standard-error heuristic.

Value

Native FPCA cross-validation result, a component count, or an auditable R data frame, according to the function.

Details

Functional PCA is refitted only on each fold's training sample and evaluated on held-out curves. The NumPy profiles order supported scalar metadata labels as pandas strings in Unicode order. The SIMD profile supports up to 256 groups with mixed-order tied counts, and any number with already sorted or distinct counts. Supply explicit fold assignments for larger mixed-order tied SIMD cohorts. The scalar profile follows NumPy introsort, including its unstable ties. Choose the profile used by the source installation. Other helpers organize preexisting uncertainty results without calculating new bootstrap intervals or certifying coverage. The 508 public Python source-contract gate remains closed.
